codeCapabilityFabric.requiredAdapter: A future bounded adapter may translate one inert shell adapter slot into an axm.code-capability-request/v1 and a digest-bound provider selection. The shell descriptor must remain embedded and unmodified.
codeCapabilityFabric.authorityBoundary: A ROUTE_PLANNED result may not alter the shell identity root, continuity, resource envelope, permissions, lineage, or memory. Execution and independent verification remain later explicit gates.

descendantGarden.requiredAdapter: A descendant enclave may receive an exported inert manifest as read-only data and propose a FORK with a new shell id. It may not mutate the parent or select inheritance.
descendantGarden.returnBoundary: Any succession, retirement, or inheritance proposal returns through an external human gate with exact parent, continuity, proposal, and decision digests.

modelShadowContinuity.boundary: Structured model-seat drift may inform a disclosed adapter-swap receipt, but matching output traces do not prove shell identity continuity, persistent mind, memory, correctness, or succession.
